
Vulnerabilities:

jinja2 2.10 has 12 known vulnerabilities:

- GHSA-h75v-3vvj-5mfj: Jinja vulnerable to HTML attribute injection when passing user input as keys to xmlattr filter

  Fixed in: 3.1.4

  Advisory information: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-34064

- GHSA-h5c8-rqwp-cp95: Jinja vulnerable to HTML attribute injection when passing user input as keys to xmlattr filter

  Fixed in: 3.1.3

  Advisory information: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-22195

- PYSEC-2019-217: No summary provided

  Fixed in: 2.10.1

  Advisory information: https://access.redhat.com/errata/RHSA-2019:1152

- PYSEC-2021-66: No summary provided

  Fixed in: 2.11.3

  Advisory information: https://snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-PYTHON-JINJA2-1012994

- PYSEC-2026-1471: Jinja2 vulnerable to sandbox breakout through attr filter selecting format method

  Fixed in: 3.1.6

  Advisory information: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-27516

- PYSEC-2026-1475: Jinja has a sandbox breakout through indirect reference to format method

  Fixed in: 3.1.5

  Advisory information: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-56326

- PYSEC-2026-1474: Jinja vulnerable to HTML attribute injection when passing user input as keys to xmlattr filter

  Fixed in: 3.1.4

  Advisory information: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-34064

- GHSA-462w-v97r-4m45: Jinja2 sandbox escape via string formatting

  Fixed in: 2.10.1

  Advisory information: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2019-10906

- PYSEC-2026-1473: Jinja vulnerable to HTML attribute injection when passing user input as keys to xmlattr filter

  Fixed in: 3.1.3

  Advisory information: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-22195

- GHSA-q2x7-8rv6-6q7h: Jinja has a sandbox breakout through indirect reference to format method

  Fixed in: 3.1.5

  Advisory information: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-56326

- GHSA-cpwx-vrp4-4pq7: Jinja2 vulnerable to sandbox breakout through attr filter selecting format method

  Fixed in: 3.1.6

  Advisory information: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-27516

- GHSA-g3rq-g295-4j3m: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) in Jinja2

  Fixed in: 2.11.3

  Advisory information: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2020-28493

urllib3 1.24.1 has 26 known vulnerabilities:

- GHSA-vxq7-64xx-v4gw: urllib3: HTTPResponse.stream()/read_chunked() buffers an unbounded chunk-size line into memory

  Fixed in: 2.8.0

  Advisory information: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-97689

- PYSEC-2026-1994: urllib3 streaming API improperly handles highly compressed data

  Fixed in: 2.6.0

  Advisory information: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-66471

- GHSA-mh33-7rrq-662w: Improper Certificate Validation in urllib3

  Advisory information: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2019-11324

- GHSA-qccp-gfcp-xxvc: urllib3: Sensitive headers forwarded across origins in proxied low-level redirects

  Advisory information: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-44431

- PYSEC-2026-4177: urllib3: HTTPResponse.stream()/read_chunked() buffers an unbounded chunk-size line into memory

  Fixed in: 2.8.0

- GHSA-2xpw-w6gg-jr37: urllib3 streaming API improperly handles highly compressed data
